messages:
kevin: Trying to publish SDK 2.4.0 from the release branch, `yarn publish` is blocked by the semver guardrail.
maria: ugh, what changed in the build? any regen diffs?
kevin: typegen output reordered an optional param in the generated `client.ts` (builder signature). It shows up as a breaking change to the type surface even though runtime is compatible.
kevin: CI shows: `ERROR: changelog missing entry for breaking change (semver-policy)`
olivia: do we have an automated changelog entry mechanism? or is this flagged by the release-lint step?
sam: release-lint flagged it after typegen-bot posted a regendiff artifact. It compares ABI / types and marks reorder as breaking by default.
typegen-bot: regendiff report uploaded: https://artifacts/internal/regendiff/1718902468
ci-bot: publish job failed: semver-check -> non-patch change detected. run `yarn typegen:inspect` locally to reproduce.
kevin: repro locally with `yarn typegen:regen && git diff --name-only` — shows `src/generated/client.ts` reorder.
maria: is it the OpenAPI spec change? or the codegen change (generator version)?
kevin: generator stable but we updated the OpenAPI schema to mark a property `id` as optional -> caused parameter to move.
olivia: hmm, optional param reorder should be non-breaking for JS consumers but TS surface treats parameter positions as part of the signature.
sam: two options: 1) adjust typegen to prefer named options object for that function, 2) make the change a documented breaking change and bump minor/major. both have tradeoffs.
kevin: leaning to avoid a major bump: can we patch the typegen to keep previous parameter order when only optionality changed?
maria: we had a similar heuristic in the past: stable parameter order unless explicit schema `x-reorder` present. but it was flaky.
olivia: For fast unblock: can we add an entry to changelog stating the signature change is intentional and mark as minor? release-lint might still block if it thinks it's breaking.
kevin: release-lint rules: if type change includes positional param removal/move -> breaking. If we re-introduce an overloaded signature keeping old shape as deprecated -> should pass.
sam: implement quick overload shim in generated code: export function foo(oldParams: A, b?: B): ... then new function with options param. Add `@deprecated` tag in comment. That preserves type compatibility.
kevin: ok i'll prototype a generator patch to emit an overload for the old signature and re-run CI.
maria: +1. if you need help with the generator heuristics I can pair.
kevin: thanks, will push a branch and ping. tagging @olivia for release notes wording.
olivia: i'll draft a short changelog note: "Type signature overload added to maintain backward compatibility after optional param reorder; deprecated old overload." keep it concise.
kevin: follow-up: if generator patch is risky, fallback is to pin the generator version we used previously and publish patch. but prefer fix in codegen.
sam: also file a quick ticket to add a test in typegen to assert stable parameter ordering for optional-only changes.
kevin: created PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/412 (WIP) — includes overload shim + regendiff snapshot.
maria: looks good from quick skim. CI will re-run once tests land.
kevin: thanks all, will update thread when publish completes :thumbsup:
